Elongated_Whip_Antennules.description: The elongated whip antennules, delicate yet formidable, serve as both sensory organs and offensive weapons for the arachnid vinegaroon, extending its reach and perception into the dark recesses of its domain, granting it the uncanny ability to navigate and attack with deadly precision in the most oppressive darkness.

Pedipalp_Copulatory_Bulbs.description: Enormous, pulsating copulatory bulbs sprout from the base of the entity's chitin-encased legs, serving as both a mesmerizing and unsettling reproductive organ, enhancing the entity's agility and charisma as it weaves through dark, tangled webs to allure and ensnare unsuspecting prey.

Silk_Spinning_Abdominal_Fingers.description: Emerging from the shadowy recesses of the entity's abdomen, these delicate yet formidable silk-spinning fingers are a marvel of arachnid engineering, capable of secreting luminous threads strong enough to ensnare even the most agile foes, while also granting the creature unparalleled dexterity and agility.

Glandular_Goo_Spitting_Palps.description: Emerging from the shadowy recesses of the arachnid's chitinous exoskeleton, the glandular goo-spitting palps are long, sinuous tentacles that pulse with a sickly green mucus, capable of firing a sticky, immobilizing substance at foes from a distance, ensnaring them in a web of paralyzing goo.

Digestive_Enzyme_Injectors.description: Equipped with chitinous tentacles that secrete corrosive acids, these injectors dissolve flesh and bone with enzymatic precision, enhancing the user's constitution while granting the terrifying ability to unleash a noxious acid breath.

Electroreceptive_Labial_Palps.description: Emerging from the shadowy depths, the electroreceptive labial palps are delicate yet sinister sensory organs, pulsating with an eerie glow as they detect the faintest electrical signals from prey and predator alike, granting their arachnid bearer a deadly advantage in the perpetual twilight of the underrealm.

Chemosensory_Tasting_Fronds.description: The Chemosensory Tasting Fronds are delicate, yet potent sensory organs that extend from the arachnid's abdomen, capable of tasting and analyzing the chemical composition of their surroundings with exquisite precision, granting them unparalleled wisdom and perception in the darkened crevices of their domain.

Prehensile_Abdominal_Lure.description: The Prehensile_Abdominal_Lure is a mesmerizing appendage, resembling delicate yet deadly tentacles, which an arachnid entity uses to weave an irresistible allure, enhancing its charisma to charm and ensnare prey or foes with a single, hypnotic gesture.

Subterranean_Root_Anchors.description: The Subterranean Root Anchors are a fearsome amalgamation of arachnid and plant, with thick, barbed tentacles that anchor the creature firmly into the earth, granting it incredible resistance to knockback and allowing it to burrow with ease, while also enhancing its strength and constitution.

Aposematic_Display_Ribbons.description: The Aposematic Display Ribbons are vibrant, bioluminescent tendrils that unfurl from the arachnid's chitin exoskeleton, pulsating with hypnotic patterns to captivate and terrify potential threats, enhancing the creature's charisma and its ability to intimidate, though they also make it more conspicuous and harder to hide.
